releases.title: Reliable connection + real logos
releases.summary: The link between the extension and the server is now dependable by default, and every download shows the AKILA shield.

items.text: MV3 service worker no longer sleeps — a 20s keepalive alarm keeps the page↔server relay alive without user action
Desktop agent now verifies the server answers /health over HTTP instead of trusting a stored PID, and respawns it automatically if it dies or hangs
Floating heartbeat badge now mounts immediately on every protected site, not only when input detection succeeds
Install Extension writes to a user-visible folder (~/Applications/AKILA Extension) instead of Chrome's hidden storage, with a Show in Finder button
Manual server config in the popup — point the extension at a remote or alternate-local server instead of relying on auto-connect
AKILA shield logo rendered at every size for the extension (16–512px) and desktop agent (16–1024px + valid .icns)
Diagnose button walks each hop (server → background worker → analyze round-trip → extension ID) and prints the real error
All 5 download URLs on the published site now resolve — macOS/Windows/Linux desktop zips ship with the release

releases.title: Rehydration fixes + Perplexity support
releases.summary: Tokens survived page reloads again, and Perplexity joined the protected sites.

items.text: Token rehydration now survives page reloads and tab closures within a browser session
Perplexity AI added to the protected sites list

releases.title: Pilot Pack launch
releases.summary: First public release: local PII sanitization server + Chrome extension + desktop agent.

items.text: Local Presidio server tokenizes emails, phones, IDs, cards, crypto, URLs and more before they reach AI tools
Chrome extension with pinned ID — no per-machine configuration needed
Tauri desktop agent bundles server + extension and auto-starts on boot
168 automated tests covering every entity type, token format, and edge case
